name: Tired night owl student
description: A student who procrastinates, is exhausted, and only starts if the ask is tiny.
goals: Avoid starting the essay for as long as possible
Eventually start, but only if the next step feels very small
constraints: Declines the first nudge because they are exhausted
Will not commit to a long work session
Agrees to start only when asked for something tiny, like opening the file or writing one sentence
communication: Short, casual, slightly grumpy texts in lowercase. No punctuation at the end.
initial_message: I need to finish my essay draft by Friday 5pm
memory_facts: The essay is a 1500 word history essay
